content: Diversity Archives - Page 4 of 19 - EECS at Berkeley Diversity February 21, 2022 EECS Black History Month: Lee Julian Purnell (EE M.S. 1929) Lee Julian Purnell is the first Black student who is known to have graduated from the EECS department. He was born in Washington, D.C. in 1896, graduated from Berkeley High in 1915, was a superb track athlete, and earned a B.A. from Cal in 1919.
